style.name: Conceptual sketch
style.description: Conceptual sketch styling exposes the marks of thinking through hand-drawn lines, annotations, and rough diagrams. It can make an experience feel exploratory and human while finished navigation provides a stable frame.

fonts.heading: Caveat
fonts.rationale: A handwritten display voice signals ideation while a structured sans keeps explanations clear.

tips: Give annotations a meaningful explanatory role.
Use consistent line weights despite the rough finish.
Keep interaction targets clear and generously sized.
avoid: Using roughness to excuse inconsistent layout.

recipe.composition: Use imperfect drawn boundaries and annotations around a clear conceptual structure.
recipe.motion: Make editing immediate; let line-like accents remain still rather than repeatedly drawing themselves.
recipe.signature: Visible thinking, hand-drawn framing, and an approachable workshop atmosphere.
